map.📖 查看「纸病（孔洞/刮痕）检测 使用指南」: 📖 View the usage guide for 'Paper Defect (Holes/Scratches) Detection'
Paper defect grading (GB/T 451.2 etc.): graded by hole diameter and count - for printing paper, a hole diameter greater than 2.0 mm or a defect count per square metre over the limit is reject; defect area ratio = Σ defect area ÷ inspected area × 100%; the grade (qualified, downgraded or reject) is decided by paper type and defect type.
map.外观质检中，按纸种与缺陷类型对照允收限（尺寸、密度）判定等级。: In appearance inspection, the grade is decided by comparing the acceptance limits (size, density) against the paper type and defect type.
map.印刷用纸对孔洞/斑点敏感，包装用纸对刮痕/气泡容忍度不同，限值各异。: Printing paper is sensitive to holes/specks, while packaging paper has a different tolerance for scratches/blisters, so the limits differ.
map.整批放行前，统计单位面积缺陷数，结合单缺陷尺寸综合评级。: Before releasing a batch, count the defects per unit area and combine them with the single-defect size for an overall grade.
map.算例：印刷纸孔洞判定（尺寸 2.5mm，密度 8 个/m²，面积 10m²）: Worked example: hole grading for printing paper (size 2.5mm, density 8 per m², area 10m²)
map.印刷纸孔洞允收限：尺寸≤2mm、密度≤5 个/m²。实测尺寸 2.5mm>2（超: Acceptance limits for printing paper holes: size≤2mm, density≤5 per m². Measured size 2.5mm>2 (oversize) and density 8>5 (over density) → reject; this 10 m² area has about 8×10=80 defects in total. Formula: total defects = density × area. [SRC]
map.尺寸与密度均不超限且均在半数以内→优等品；均不超限→一等品；仅一项不超限→合格品: Both size and density within limits and both within half the limit → superior grade; both within limits → first grade; only one within limits → qualified; both over limits → reject. Look up the limit table for the paper type.
map.不同纸种的缺陷限值一样吗？: Are the defect limits the same for different paper types?
map.不一样。本工具内置印刷/包装/生活/工业四类限值：如孔洞，印刷纸尺寸≤2mm、密: No. This tool has built-in limits for four categories: printing/packaging/tissue/industrial paper. For holes, printing paper is size≤2mm and density≤5, while industrial paper is relaxed to size≤10mm and density≤10. Choosing the wrong paper type gives a wrong verdict.
map.尺寸和密度哪个更关键？: Which matters more, size or density?
map.都关键，但大尺寸缺陷（孔洞、气泡）对印刷断纸/外观影响更致命，通常优先卡尺寸；密: Both matter, but large-size defects (holes, blisters) are more damaging to print break-through and appearance, so size is usually checked first; density reflects overall cleanliness. Exceeding either limit at the same time means reject.
map.纸病检测依据GB/T 451.2《纸和纸板定量的测定》及GB/T 15442相关: Paper defect detection is based on GB/T 451.2 'Determination of grammage of paper and board' and related GB/T 15442 standards
map.印刷用纸要求最严格，孔洞≤2mm且≤5个/m²；包装用纸可适当放宽: Printing paper has the strictest requirements: holes≤2mm and ≤5 per m²; packaging paper may be moderately relaxed
map.孔洞和裂口影响印刷和包装性能，严重时导致断纸或印刷漏印: Holes and tears affect printing and packaging performance, and in severe cases cause break-through or missing print
map.检测应在标准光源下进行，检测面积不少于5m²以保证统计可靠性: Detection should be carried out under standard light sources, over an area of at least 5m² to ensure statistical reliability
map.常见原因：网部成型不良、压榨部压力不均、烘缸表面污染等: Common causes: poor formation on the wire, uneven press pressure, contamination of the dryer drum surface, etc.
map.纸张缺陷检测判定工具，输入缺陷类型、尺寸和数量，按GB/T标准判定纸张质量等级(: A paper-defect screening tool that flags risk levels from defect type, size and count using built-in reference thresholds; results are not a national-standard pass/fail judgement.
map.支持五种常见纸病类型: Supports five common paper defect types
map.不同纸张类型自动匹配限值: Automatically matches limits for different paper types
map.尺寸和数量双重判定: Dual judgement by size and count
map.输入纸张缺陷类型和参数，按内置参考阈值提示质量风险；结果不构成标准合格判定。: Enter the paper defect type and parameters to screen quality against built-in reference thresholds; results are not a standard pass/fail judgement.
map.参考筛查口径（非国家标准判定）：按最大缺陷尺寸与每平方米缺陷数对照内置参考阈值；: Reference screening criteria (not a national-standard judgement): compare maximum defect size and defects per m² with built-in thresholds; when both are within threshold, split into reference excellent / reference first grade by whether both are below half the threshold; any exceedance is flagged. These thresholds are for quick screening only and do not replace contracts, product standards or third-party test reports.
map.外观质检中，按纸种与缺陷类型对照内置参考阈值（尺寸、密度）提示风险等级。: In appearance QC, use built-in reference thresholds (size, density) for the paper and defect type to flag risk levels.
map.印刷用纸对孔洞/斑点敏感，包装用纸对刮痕/气泡容忍度不同，参考阈值各异。: Printing paper is sensitive to holes and specks, while packaging paper tolerates scratches and blisters differently, so reference thresholds vary.
map.整批放行前，统计单位面积缺陷数，结合单缺陷尺寸做初步筛查，再按合同或产品标准复核: Before lot release, count defects per unit area and screen by maximum defect size, then verify against the contract or product standard.
map.印刷纸孔洞内置参考阈值：尺寸≤2mm、密度≤5 个/m²。实测尺寸 2.5mm>: Built-in reference threshold for printing-paper holes: size ≤2mm, density ≤5 per m². Measured size 2.5mm > 2 and density 8 > 5 both exceed the threshold; the 10 m² area has about 80 defects by density × area. This only flags screening risk and is not a national-standard non-conformance judgement.
map.尺寸与密度均在阈值内且均不超过阈值一半→参考优等；均在阈值内→参考一等；仅一项超: Both within threshold and both at or below half → reference excellent; both within threshold → reference first grade; one exceeds → one metric exceeds reference threshold; both exceed → both metrics exceed reference threshold. Thresholds are built in by paper type and do not replace the contract or product standard.
map.不同纸种的缺陷阈值一样吗？: Are defect thresholds the same for different paper types?
map.不一样。本工具内置印刷/包装/生活/工业四类参考阈值：如孔洞，印刷纸尺寸≤2mm: No. Built-in reference thresholds cover printing, packaging, tissue and industrial paper. For holes, printing paper is ≤2mm and ≤5 per m², while industrial paper is relaxed to ≤10mm and ≤10 per m². A wrong paper type shifts the reference result; these thresholds are not national-standard limits.
map.都关键，但大尺寸缺陷（孔洞、气泡）对印刷断纸/外观影响更致命，通常优先卡尺寸；密: Both matter, but large defects (holes, blisters) are more damaging to print runnability and appearance, so size is usually gated first; density reflects overall cleanliness. When both exceed, the tool flags both metrics; whether the lot is non-conforming still depends on the contract or product standard.
map.本工具阈值仅用于快速筛查，不构成国家标准合格判定；放行、索赔请以合同、产品标准和: Thresholds are for quick screening only and are not a national-standard pass/fail judgement; release and claims must rely on the contract, product standard and third-party test reports.
map.内置参考阈值中印刷用纸最严格（孔洞≤2mm 且≤5 个/m²），包装用纸相对放宽: Among the built-in reference thresholds, printing paper is strictest (holes ≤2mm and ≤5 per m²); packaging paper is relatively relaxed.
map.检测应在均匀照明下进行；检测面积过小会放大抽样波动，建议按企业抽样方案执行: Inspect under uniform lighting; a small inspection area amplifies sampling variation, so follow the company sampling plan.
map.判定口径：本工具内置参考阈值，非国家标准合格判定；如需放行或索赔，请以合同、产品: Basis: built-in reference thresholds, not a national-standard pass/fail judgement. For release or claims, rely on the contract, product standard and third-party test reports.
map.单项超出参考阈值: One metric exceeds the reference threshold
map.两项均超出参考阈值: Both metrics exceed the reference threshold
map.尺寸未知（仅有每 m² 估计密度）: Size unknown (only estimated density per m²)
map.外观质检中，按纸种与缺陷类型对照内置参考阈值（尺寸、密度）做筛查提示，不生成法定: In appearance inspection, screen against built-in reference thresholds (size, density) by paper type and defect type; no statutory pass/fail judgement is produced.
map.记录缺陷时先区分“未检出”“尺寸未知”“已测缺陷”；信息不全时不输出等级。: Record “not detected”, “size unknown” or “measured defect” first; incomplete information produces no grade.
map.算例：印刷纸孔洞（尺寸 2.5mm，估计密度 8 个/m²，面积 10m²）: Example: printing-paper holes (size 2.5 mm, estimated density 8/m², area 10 m²)
map.印刷纸孔洞参考阈值：尺寸≤2mm、密度≤5 个/m²。尺寸 2.5>2、密度 8: Printing-paper hole reference thresholds: size ≤2 mm, density ≤5/m². Size 2.5 > 2 and density 8 > 5, so both exceed the reference; about 80 defects are estimated in 10 m². This is screening risk only, not a statutory non-conformance judgement.
map.若尺寸>0 而密度=0，或密度>0 而尺寸=0，页面提示相互矛盾，不生成等级；未: Size > 0 with density = 0, or density > 0 with size = 0, is flagged as contradictory and produces no grade; “not detected” requires both 0, “size unknown” requires size 0 and density > 0.
map.页面按“每 m² 估计密度”记录，总缺陷数=密度×检测面积，是面积外推估计，不是: Density is recorded as an estimate per m²; total defects = density × inspected area, an area extrapolation, not a sheet-by-sheet count. Size and density should come from the same sample.
map.未检出和尺寸未知有什么区别？: What is the difference between “not detected” and “size unknown”?
map.未检出表示尺寸与密度均为 0，不生成等级；尺寸未知表示只有估计密度、缺少最大尺寸: “Not detected” means both size and density are 0 and no grade is produced; “size unknown” means only estimated density is available and no grade is produced. Neither is a measured defect with size 0.
map.纸病快速筛查工具，输入缺陷类型、尺寸和数量，按内置参考阈值提示风险等级；结果不构: Rapid paper-defect screening: enter defect type, size and count to get a reference-threshold risk prompt; the result is not a statutory pass/fail judgement.
